budget_items.what_was_recorded: Reported prospect that state aid could decline by 20% to 25%, and advice to plan conservatively for a cut of up to 20-25% in local aid.
budget_items.quote: the prospect is that state aid could decline by 20% to 25%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Heather said rainy-day funds and the Cares Act could help; Peter said the rainy day fund would be depleted quickly.
budget_items.quote: heather said the rainy-day funds and the cares act could help.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager reported on the list of projects and costs sent to Rep. Hay in February and a chance of partial state funding through a bond issuance.
budget_items.quote: there is a chance to get partial funding from the state.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Dave Passios wants a funding source for the streetlights, which would reduce expenses; sufficient free cash makes this less urgent; Peter asked whether the Town could appropriate free cash under a one-twelfth budget.
budget_items.quote: now that there is sufficient free cash this is less urgent.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Damon McQuaid emphasized that costs of ALS equipment, which is highly specialized, could increase if its replacement is postponed.
budget_items.quote: damon m. emphasized the risk that costs of als equipment, which is highly specialized gear, could increase.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Peter listed the big projects (TC Passios, Turkey Hill Building, renovation or disposal of vacated space) whose combined cost may be about that of the Middle-High School project, affecting debt levels and the tax rate.
budget_items.quote: totaling all the costs may be about what the cost of the middle-high school project.
